title: Copilot Studio: Python Code node as a step in workflows
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and accurately describes documented workflow billing and environment capacity controls. Its gaps are confined to the Python Code node itself; targeted searches found no documentation resolving those gaps.

claims.claim: Using LLMs under the Microsoft Copilot harness consumes credits.
claims.quote: For experiences powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, Copilot Credits are charged for large language model (LLM) tokens, tools (including knowledge and MCPs), and the harness itself. Any experience that uses one of these consumes credits.

claims.claim: Credit capacity and allocation are managed per environment and govern the capacity workflows consume.
claims.quote: Administrators can allocate credits to environments and monitor usage to ensure that sufficient credits are available. If you need credits assigned to your environment, contact your administrator.

claims.claim: API credit allocation requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or equivalent licensing and capacity management permissions.
claims.quote: Permission to manage licensing and capacity. Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: The allocation path is Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Under the Copilot Studio heading, select Manage Copilot Credits or Manage sessions. In the allocation panel, select an environment and specify the number of Copilot Credits to allocate in the Copilot Credits textbox.

claims.where: controls[0].note: tenant overage path; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The allocation panel's Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant option allows use of unallocated tenant prepaid capacity.
claims.quote: Under Capacity overages, choose how an environment can continue using Copilot Credits after it exhausts its allocated capacity: Select Draw from the available capacity in my tenant to let the environment use unallocated prepaid capacity from the tenant pool.

claims.where: controls[0].note: pay-as-you-go path; Governance controls table

claims.claim: A published environment group rule governing tenant capacity draw causes individual environment changes in the UI or API to fail with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: If a published environment group rule governs Draw from the available capacity in my tenant, you can't override the setting for an individual environment. Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits.
claims.quote: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits. Experiences that require credits can stop working after that allocation is exhausted.

claims.claim: Data policies are a general control over connectors in Copilot Studio agents.
claims.quote: To prevent agent makers from using Power Platform connectors as tools in Copilot Studio agents, configure a data policy with the connectors you want to block.
